- **FR-882** and **PD-4821** belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account.

Moss's other notes (both cheat sheets and the North team digests) have no Marrow Fieldworks tickets. Our DM has nothing beyond your request. I also checked #central-team, which only has Agrisupply and Tansleigh Packaging tickets and nothing from this week.
